en: n. a large number of things lying on top of each other; a large amount of something; a very large building; (v.) to put things in a heap
ex: There was a pile of dirty dishes in the sink.
水槽裡堆著一大堆髒碗盤。

en: a device or large piece of equipment used for cooking food; (BrE) a cooking apple; a person who falsifies records
ex: She put the rice cooker on and started chopping vegetables.
她開了電鍋，然後開始切菜。

en: n. the feeling of needing food; a strong desire for something; a lack of food that causes suffering; v. to suffer from lack of food; to have a strong desire for something
ex: Millions of people in the region are suffering from hunger.
該地區有數百萬人正飽受飢餓之苦。

en: to state or show that something is definitely true; to make something definite or official; to make a feeling or belief stronger
ex: Please confirm your reservation by email before Friday.
請在週五前以電子郵件確認您的訂位。

en: the joint between the hand and the arm
ex: He twisted his wrist while playing basketball.
他打籃球時扭傷了手腕。

en: n. a quality that attracts people and makes them like you; a small object believed to bring good luck; v. to attract or delight someone; to influence someone with your charm
ex: The old town has a certain charm that attracts tourists.
這座老城有一種吸引遊客的獨特魅力。

en: behavior that is intended to hurt or kill someone; great physical force; strong or extreme feeling or effect
ex: The film was criticized for its excessive violence.
這部電影因為過度暴力而受到批評。

en: n. an arm or a leg of a person or animal; a large branch of a tree; a part that extends from the main body; v. to cut off the arms or legs from a body
ex: The injured soldier lost a limb in the war.
受傷的士兵在戰爭中失去了一條肢體。

en: n. a legal process in which a court examines evidence to decide guilt; a test of something to see if it works; a difficult experience; a. relating to a test
ex: The trial lasted for three weeks before the jury reached a verdict.
審判進行了三週，陪審團才做出裁決。

en: a. difficult to deal with or needing careful handling; clever at deceiving people; (of a situation) likely to cause problems
ex: Parking in the city center can be tricky on weekends.
週末在市中心停車可能很棘手。

en: an area of land under the control of a particular country or ruler; an area where an animal lives and defends; an area of activity or knowledge
ex: The two countries have been fighting over the disputed territory for decades.
兩國為了爭議領土已交戰數十年。

en: a person who makes or invents something; (the Creator) God
ex: The creator of the cartoon character won a major award.
這個卡通角色的創作者獲得了一項重要大獎。

en: the years of a person's life from age 13 to 19; (informal) a number between 13 and 19
ex: She became interested in fashion during her teens.
她在青少年時期對時尚產生了興趣。

en: to discover or notice something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, or feel; to find out that something is present
ex: The new machine can detect small amounts of dangerous chemicals.
這台新機器能偵測出微量的危險化學物質。

en: n. a brass musical instrument with a bell-shaped end; the loud sound of an elephant; v. to blow a trumpet; to announce something loudly and proudly
ex: He learned to play the trumpet when he was ten.
他十歲時學會吹小號。

en: n. bread that has been cooked until brown on both sides; an act of drinking to someone's health; v. to make bread brown by heating; to drink to someone's success or good health; to warm something
ex: Let's raise our glasses and toast the happy couple.
讓我們舉杯為這對新人乾杯。

en: to remove something completely, especially writing or marks; to remove information from a computer; to make someone forget something
ex: Please erase the board before the next class starts.
請在下一堂課開始前把黑板擦乾淨。

en: v. to take air into your lungs and send it out again; to live; to say something quietly; to give new life to something
ex: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly.
深吸一口氣，慢慢地呼吸。

en: a special vehicle for taking sick or injured people to a hospital quickly
ex: An ambulance arrived within five minutes of the accident.
事故發生後五分鐘內救護車就到了。
ph: 專門攬事故官司的律師

en: the use of violence and threats to frighten people, often for political purposes; a state of fear caused by such acts
ex: The government has promised stronger action against terrorism.
政府承諾要對恐怖主義採取更強硬的行動。

en: a. clean and arranged carefully; skillful and well done; (US informal) very good; (of an alcoholic drink) served without ice or water; n. a cow or an ox
ex: Her room is always neat and tidy.
她的房間總是整潔有序。

en: n. the people who work for a company or organization; a stick used as a support; a set of five lines used in written music; v. to provide a company with workers
ex: The hotel staff were very friendly and helpful.
飯店的員工非常親切又樂於助人。

en: wanting more food, money or power than you need; eating too much
ex: The greedy boy ate all the cookies by himself.
那個貪吃的男孩獨自把所有餅乾吃光了。

en: n. a bright flash of light in the sky during a storm; a. very fast; v. to produce lightning
ex: The tree was struck by lightning during the storm.
那棵樹在暴風雨中被閃電擊中。

en: v. to mix a liquid by moving a spoon around in it; to move slightly; to make someone feel a strong emotion; n. a state of excitement; a prison (slang)
ex: Stir the soup occasionally so it doesn't burn.
偶爾攪拌一下湯，免得燒焦。

en: n. a job or series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work; the period of time spent in a particular job; v. to move quickly and in an uncontrolled way
ex: She has had a successful career as a lawyer for twenty years.
她擔任律師已有二十年的成功職涯。

en: able to be seen; clearly noticeable or obvious; (n.) a thing or person that can be seen
ex: The stars are visible on a clear night.
晴朗的夜晚看得見星星。

en: n. a path, route or course; a mark left behind by a person or animal; a piece of music on a CD or album; a pair of rails for trains; v. to follow someone or something; to find someone or something by following signs
ex: The police followed the tracks of the car through the snow.
警方沿著雪地上的車痕追蹤。

en: n. the part of a telephone that you hold to your ear; a person who receives something; a device that receives radio or TV signals; a person who buys or deals in stolen goods
ex: She picked up the receiver and dialed the number.
她拿起話筒撥了號碼。

en: to make air, water or land dirty or harmful, especially with chemicals or waste; to damage someone's mind or morals
ex: Factories that pollute the river will be fined.
汙染河川的工廠將被處以罰款。

en: adv. as a result of what has just been said; in this way; to this degree
ex: He didn't study hard; thus, he failed the exam.
他沒有認真念書，因此考試沒及格。

en: a country ruled by a king or queen; an area of activity, thought or nature that is considered as a group
ex: The prince will inherit the kingdom when his father dies.
王子將在父親去世後繼承王國。

en: (of air or climate) containing a lot of water vapor, making it feel warm and sticky
ex: The weather in Taiwan is hot and humid in summer.
台灣夏天的天氣又熱又潮溼。

en: n. the name of a book, film or piece of music; a word showing a person's rank or job; a legal right to own property; the position of champion; v. to give a name to something
ex: The title of the movie is hard to remember.
這部電影的片名很難記。

en: n. old or useless things that you do not want; (informal) food that is bad for you; a flat-bottomed Chinese sailing boat; v. to throw something away
ex: The garage is full of old junk that nobody uses.
車庫裡堆滿了沒人用的舊雜物。

en: n. a small swelling on a plant from which a leaf or flower grows; v. to produce buds; to begin to grow
ex: The cherry trees are covered with pink buds in early spring.
櫻花樹在初春時長滿粉紅色的花苞。

en: adv. at a greater distance in space or time; to a greater degree or extent; a. more distant; additional
ex: The next gas station is two kilometers farther down the road.
下一個加油站在這條路再過去兩公里。

en: a. not bright or clear; difficult to see; (informal) not intelligent; v. to make a light less bright
ex: The dim light in the room made it hard to read.
房間裡昏暗的燈光讓人很難看書。

en: v. to tell people about a product or service in order to persuade them to buy it; to make something publicly known; n. (advertisement/ad) a notice or short film that tries to persuade people to buy something
ex: The company spends millions of dollars to advertise its new products.
這家公司花了數百萬美元為新產品打廣告。

en: n. the act of coming or going in; a door or gate for going in; the right to enter; an item recorded in a book or database; a person or thing that takes part in a competition
ex: No entry without a ticket.
無票者禁止進入。
